parts.label: (a)
parts.answer: At particular angles, the path difference between waves from adjacent slits is a whole number nλ. The waves then arrive in phase and interfere constructively, producing a bright maximum.
accepted_alternatives: Bright maxima occur where the adjacent-slit phase difference is a whole number of cycles, so the coherent waves reinforce.

marking_points.text: States that the path difference between waves from adjacent slits is nλ or a whole number of wavelengths.
Explains that the waves arrive in phase and interfere constructively to form a bright maximum.
